# MTM 18+

MTM 18+ is the largest and longest running study on media and technology among the adult Canadian population. By taking an exhaustive approach, it provides key insights to understand your audiences or users.

[Request a Demo](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/fr/request-demo/)

Decades Of Data

MTM 18+ has been gathering data since 2001 on large array of topics.

Large, Robust Sampling

We've surveyed more than 300,000 adult Canadians to date and reach an additional 12,000 or more annually.

Exhaustive Value For Clients

Clients gain access to a full suite of more than 45 reports annually and thousands of variables across our suite of tools.

A Fully Bilingual Product

All content available through MTM 18+ and the rest of the MTM product suite is offered in English and French.

Data On Canadians From Coast To Coast To Coast

The MTM offers data on every region and province, including the North.

Explore our suite of tools and leverage data insights for confident decision-making on Canadian adults.

Past month usage has increased from 3% in Fall 2019 to 23% in Fall 2025.

## Research Methodology

MTM 18+ is based on a nationally representative telephone survey with a follow up online compontent, reaching Canadian adults across all provinces and territories.

Sample Coverage

- 12,000+ Canadian adults surveyed annually

  The largest on-going survey of its kind.

- 300,000+ Canadian adults surveyed to date

  Decades of results available.

- 6,000+/6,000+ Anglophone/Francophone respondents

  Large, viable samples for either Official Canadian language market.

Survey Design

- 25+ Years of data collection

  Industry standard level tracking

- 22% Response rate

  Exceeds industry standards

- Two-Part Survey structure

  Respondents complete a phone survey and an additional follow up online survey, with questions optomized for each medium

Sample Composition

Landline Proportion

57%

Cellphone Only Household (CPO) Proportion

43%

Sample composition is weighted to reflect the national distribution of Canadian households.

Research Provider

- ![Forum Research](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/products/mtm-18-plus/forum_research_logo.png)

  The MTM and all of its surveys are a product of CBC/Radio-Canada Research and Analysis. Forum Research conducts all of the French and English research for the MTM 18+. Established in 1993, Forum Research Inc. is a Canadian market research and technology company, with offices in Toronto, Montreal, and Saskatoon. With over 30 years of experience, they combine industry talent, cutting-edge technology, and behavioral science to provide in-depth insights.
